metadata.protocol: Normalized content deduplication; conflicting labels removed; normalized headline groups held together; 60/20/20 group split; vectorizer fitted on training only; sigmoid calibration fitted on validation only. No publisher or temporal holdout.
limits: Historical English articles; not evaluated on Hindi, short claims, or current events.
Publisher and writing-style cues may inflate in-domain scores.
Grouped holdout does not remove all semantic near-duplicates.
Classifier probabilities describe dataset labels, not verified factual truth.
Latency measures sparse matrix scoring plus calibration, excluding text processing and network time.
